    SELECT 
        sh.School AS school_name,
        sh.County AS county_name,
        ROUND(ss.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / ss.NumTstTakr, 2) AS excellence_rate,
        f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_eligibility_percent,
        ss.enroll12 AS total_enrollment

)

    school_name,
    county_name,
    excellence_rate,
    frpm_eligibility_percent,
